name: GDAL
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Geospatial CLI suite that reprojects, clips and converts raster and vector map data
summary: GDAL is the standard geospatial library and CLI set: gdalwarp reprojects and clips rasters, gdal_translate converts and rescales them, ogr2ogr reprojects and clips vector data to GeoJSON, gdalinfo reports CRS and extents. It is the data step before a map scene or still, not a renderer.
use_when: A DEM or satellite raster must be reprojected, clipped or converted before a map scene uses it
Vector data in an exotic GIS format must become clean GeoJSON in a chosen CRS
CRS, extents or pixel values of a geo file must be checked by script
avoid_when: Dissolving or simplifying boundary GeoJSON with no GDAL install: mapshaper
Rendering styled map stills from vector tiles: chiitiler or maplibre-native
Projecting geometry inside a seeked scene: d3

install.macos: conda route used in VCR: micromamba create -p <dir> -c conda-forge gdal=3.13.2; or brew install gdal (failed on one machine: conflict with fbthrift)

notes: 2026-11-27: the lead said 3.13.3 on gdal.org; conda-forge carried 3.13.2, which is what ran.
2026-11-27: brew install gdal failed on the test machine because of a conflict with fbthrift; the fixture builds a conda-forge env under its ignored output/.
2026-11-27: set GDAL_PAM_ENABLED=NO so gdalinfo does not write .aux.xml files beside the data.

assessment.rationale: GDAL 3.13.2 on conda-forge (release dated 2026-07-20 by gdalinfo); MIT. The only catalogued route that reprojects and clips rasters and converts GIS vector formats; mapshaper covers GeoJSON only and chiitiler and maplibre-native draw styled tiles. Install is heavy and one route failed, so keep as candidate pending review.

evidence.result: 10x10 ASCII grid to EPSG:4326 GeoTIFF; warped to EPSG:3857 (11x18 px at 50 km); cutline-clipped to 7x7; GeoJSON reprojected and bbox-clipped (2 features, metres); pixels 0 and 99 read back; two runs byte-identical. conda-forge env.
evidence.scope: Tiny self-authored data, gdal_translate, gdalwarp, ogr2ogr, gdalinfo on macOS arm64 via conda-forge; not Homebrew, hillshade or gdaldem, real DEMs, other CPUs or other PROJ data.
